synopsis: I've known Ta-kun ever since we were 10 years old. Even though we are now in high school, we still spend our days in his room, talking about nothing in particular. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.
